We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got product(s). The apply_template returned three possible precursors (tuples). The result is a tuple of strings? It gave three strings: 
1) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
2) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'
3) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C'

Actually the result shows three tuples each containing a string? It shows (('...'), ('...'), ('...')). So three possible precursors.

We need to construct a route using these templates sequentially. Likely each step transforms product to precursors.

We need to pick one branch that can continue through the remaining templates.

We need to apply template 1914389 to one of the precursors from step 1. We checked that the first precursor matches template 1914389 (True). Applying gave two products: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'.

So applying 1914389 to the first precursor yields two possible outcomes (maybe forward/backward). We need retrosynthetic direction: we start from target, apply template 29646 to get precursors (retro). Then apply 1914389 to each precursor? Actually we need a linear route of 5 steps using those templates in order. So step1: target -> precursors via 29646. Choose one precursor that can be further transformed by 1914389. The first precursor matches 1914389, giving two possible precursors. Choose one that can be further transformed by 1914390.

We tried 1914390 on 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and got false. Also on the other product 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' also false. So maybe we need to choose the second precursor from step1 (the one without Si) which is 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C' . Check if matches 1914389? earlier we checked false. So maybe we need to apply 1914389 to the first precursor but then need to apply 1914390 to the second product of that step? Let's test 1914390 on 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' we already did false. So maybe we need to apply 1914390 to something else later.

Maybe the route is not linear but branching; we need at least 5 reactions total, could be tree. Use each template somewhere.

We still have templates 1914390, 149040, 1914391 left. Need to get precursors that match them.

We haven't retrieved template 1914391.
